description: The Bahamas National Geographic Information Systems (BNGIS) Centre is the government's national GIS office, and this service page explains how the public can obtain maps from its library. The page read on 2026-09-28 says zoning, subdivision and maritime maps, among others, can be requested from the centre and that the service is open to all interested persons or entities; the site also lists an interactive map and map publication pages, and the centre's technical support to the Port Department, the Ministry of Works, Civil Aviation, National Security and the National Emergency Management Agency, with training in GPS and oil trajectory modelling. Coverage is the Commonwealth of The Bahamas. Access is on request; fees, formats and licence are not stated. Caveats: the map library is not browsable online, and the interactive map was not read. It supports reference layers for hazard exposure studies of the islands, such as zoning and subdivisions under hurricane storm surge. No related Bahamas GIS record is catalogued; national census data complement it.
